data.prompt: Apply the exact six-word headline FALSE ALARM. / IT'S JUST / THE BOX. once in uppercase Avenir Next Condensed Demi Bold, 64 px, dark brown #3B2420, left aligned at x=72 and y=48 with restrained three-line spacing. Change typography only over the empty upper-left plaster field; preserve every person, table, wrapping, and exact-source package pixel. Add no other text, logo, price, badge, button, frame, CTA, or watermark.
data.changesFromParent: Add only the assigned Arm B headline in the empty upper-left wall field.
notes: The exact headline is spelled once in the upper-left wall field without covering the guests or package.
